answer.text: For riding solo, the manual gives 32 psi (2.24 kg/cm²) for the front tyre.

policy.text: Inflate the tyres to the correct air pressure the manual specifies.

watchouts.text: An under-inflated tyre may overheat, become damaged and cause injury to the rider.
